stations.title: Wendell
stations.say: Which van test do I believe?

stations.title: Lorcan's tests
stations.text: One van and one log, shared by every test.

stations.title: Your tests
stations.gap: Each test needs the one before

captions: Wendell asks why a van test passes with the others but fails when Effie runs it alone.
Lorcan's tests share one van, so each test finds what the one before it left there.
You give every test a fresh van of its own and clear the day's log after each one.
Now the weighing test passes alone, with the others, and with the order turned round.
Same van code, tests you can run in any order. A red test now points at the code.
